name: Pay Pals
tagline: Turns personal goals into friendly wagers your friends can back.

awards: Best Finance Hack Sponsored By Capital One

problem: People abandon personal goals without accountability.
solution: Users set goals in lobbies where friends place favour-based bets, with bank and on-chain tools verifying users.
demo_moment: Team-described: create a goal lobby and see friends' wagers.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Finance Hack Sponsored By Capital One” among 112 submissions.
Makes goals a spectator sport among friends.
